claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Vicriviroc is a CCR5 antagonist that does not directly kill cells at 2.5 uM; it only blocks CCR5-mediated invasion and enhances DNA-damage-induced killing, so it is expected to be largely inactive as a monotherapy in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
